player_0.content: New plan: My previous attempt failed because I assigned a high score (8) to "Confident," which contradicts the context of the dialogue. Jamal is being threatened with failure and told the project is "on him," which creates a defensive and defiant stance rather than genuine confidence. While he is defiant (9) and likely resentful (6) of Sophia's rigid approach, the threat of failure should lower his confidence score significantly. Next time, I will re-evaluate the emotional weight of the final lines ("if this project fails, it's on you") to ensure the scores reflect the tension and risk, likely lowering "Confident" to a low value (e.g., 2) and potentially increasing "Worried" or keeping "Defiant" as the dominant emotion. I will ensure the scores align with the character's defensive reaction to a direct threat rather than an optimistic outlook.
